rev6.release_notes: Safer updates: an update now waits for G-SEND.IO to close completely and puts the old files back if anything goes wrong, so a failed update can no longer leave G-SEND.IO unable to start. Program Manager's design sync: the tick boxes are visible, Select all / none, and Export says what it needs. Also: Simulate's lathe Tools list and stock size boxes, and Check for Updates reports CAD CAM too.

cadcam.release_notes: Beta 2: the CAD / CAM switch stays where you put it; clicking a setup (or Ctrl-picking toolpaths) shows all their toolpath lines; six new tool models for Simulate (1/2, 3/4 and 1 in end mills, a No. 3 center drill, a 1/4 in drill, a 1.25 in face mill).
